svg.title: OCR TRILOGY
svg.desc: OCR trilogy: one Tesseract OCR engine shipped three ways. 2020 FastAPI on Heroku, 2021 Flask-RESTX image on Docker Hub, 2022 Flask web UI with Heroku and Azure continuous deployment. Ties to his Tesseract OCR services work in healthcare.
svg.text: One OCR engine, three deployments: FastAPI on
Heroku, then Flask-RESTX on Docker Hub, then a
Flask web UI with Heroku + Azure CD.
